```{r package setup, include = FALSE}
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r}
#read in full sheet from xlsx file
df_full <- read.xlsx("Ropivacaine_Dexmed_Data_AH.xlsx", sheet = "Full") %>%
  #drop any completely empty rows
  filter(!is.na(Variable))

#choosing horse (THIS ALLOWS FOR VERY EASY MANIPULATION AND VIEWING FOR HORSES AND TREATMENTS)
sel_horse <- "8"
sel_trt   <- "DR"
 
```

```{r}
#making subset for one horse (and changing CTT to long form)
df_one_ctt <- df_full %>%
  filter(Horse == sel_horse, Treatment == sel_trt, Variable == "CTT (cm)") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c('Time.-.Baseline', matches("^[0-9]+$")),
    names_to  = "time_label",
    values_to = "ctt_cm"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    #parse whatever digits are in the label
    time_min = parse_number(time_label),
    #replace that NA with 0
    time_min = replace_na(time_min, 0)
  )

#plotting
ggplot(df_one_ctt, aes(x = time_min, y = ctt_cm)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("CTT (cm) Over Time: Horse ", sel_horse, " (", sel_trt, ")"),
    x     = "Time (min)",
    y     = "CTT (cm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```


```{r}
#Summarized Table (From Excel)
df_summ2 <- read.xlsx(
  "Ropivacaine_Dexmed_Data_AH.xlsx",
  sheet = "Summarized"
) %>%
  rename(
    horse                     = Horse,
    treatment                 = Treatment,
    period                    = Period,
    minimum_ctt_cm            = `Minimum.CTT.(cm)`,
    duration_of_min_ctt_min   = `Duration.of.Min.CTT.(min)`,
    maximum_corneal_pressure  = Maximum.corneal.pressure,
    total_anesthesia_time_min = `Total.Anesthesia.Time.(min)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    horse     = factor(horse),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("DR", "R", "S")),
    period    = factor(period)
  )

#pull the matching summarized row into a new object
example_summary_matched2 <- df_summ2 %>%
  filter(horse == sel_horse, treatment == sel_trt) %>%
  select(
    minimum_ctt_cm,
    duration_of_min_ctt_min,
    total_anesthesia_time_min
  )

#pivot longer so we have Metric / Value
example_summary_matched2_long <- example_summary_matched2 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = everything(),
    names_to  = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(Metric,
      minimum_ctt_cm            = "Minimum CTT (cm)",
      duration_of_min_ctt_min   = "Duration of Min CTT (min)",
      total_anesthesia_time_min = "Total Anesthesia Time (min)"
    )
  )

#print it
example_summary_matched2_long %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Metric", "Value"),
    caption   = paste0(
      "Summarized Metrics for Horse ",
      sel_horse, " (Treatment ", sel_trt, ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    full_width        = FALSE,
    font_size         = 12,
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down")
  )
```

```{r}
#Summarized Table (By Hand)

#recompute only from df_one_ctt:
example_summary_ctt_only <- df_one_ctt %>%
  summarise(
    `Minimum CTT (cm)`          = min(ctt_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
    # sum the number of times at that minimum, then *10 min per interval
    `Duration of Min CTT (min)` = sum(ctt_cm == `Minimum CTT (cm)`, na.rm = TRUE) * 10,
    `Total Anesthesia Time (min)` = {
      # baseline at t=0
      baseline_val <- first(ctt_cm[time_min == 0], default = NA_real_)
      # remove the t=0 row before looking for returns
      tmp <- df_one_ctt %>% filter(time_min > 0)
      is_base <- tmp$ctt_cm == baseline_val
      times2  <- tmp$time_min
      # find first pair of consecutive TRUEs
      consec  <- which(is_base[-length(is_base)] & is_base[-1])
      if (length(consec) > 0) times2[consec[1]] 
      else max(times2[!is.na(tmp$ctt_cm)], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  )

#pivot longer and print
example_summary_ctt_only %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = everything(),
    names_to  = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Metric", "Value"),
    caption   = paste0(
      "Manual CTT‐Only Summary for Horse ", sel_horse,
      " (Treatment ", sel_trt, ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    full_width        = FALSE,
    font_size         = 12
  )
```


# Working With ALL Horses
```{r}
df_full_long <- df_full %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -c(Horse, Treatment, Variable),
    names_to  = "time_label",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time_min = replace_na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(time_label)), 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(time_min))

# summarize only at actual measurement times, allow each panel its own x- and y-limits
df_timecourse_summary <- df_full_long %>%
  filter(
    Variable %in% c("CTT (cm)", "Corneal Pressure (g/mm2)"),
    !is.na(value)
  ) %>%
  group_by(time_min, Treatment, Variable) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    lo  = min(value,    na.rm = TRUE),
    hi  = max(value,    na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(df_timecourse_summary, aes(x = time_min, y = med, color = Treatment, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = "Full Time Course: Median ± Min/Max by Treatment",
    x     = "Time (min)",
    y     = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```
```{r}
# 1) Pull the already‐computed CTT TTA from your summary object
ctt_tta_val <- example_summary_matched2_long %>%
  filter(Metric == "Total Anesthesia Time (min)") %>%
  pull(Value)

# 2) Compute Pressure‐based TTA: two consecutive returns within ±0.5, take the *second* one
pressure_df <- df_full_long %>%
  filter(
    Horse     == sel_horse,
    Treatment == sel_trt,
    Variable  == "Corneal Pressure (g/mm2)"
  )

baseline_cp <- first(pressure_df$value[pressure_df$time_min == 0])

# drop time 0, flag close readings, then find the consecutive pairs
df2    <- pressure_df %>% filter(time_min > 0)
ok     <- abs(df2$value - baseline_cp) <= 0.5
times  <- df2$time_min
consec <- which(ok[-length(ok)] & ok[-1])

# take the *second* of the first consecutive pair
tta_cp <- if (length(consec)) times[consec[1] + 1] else NA_real_

# 3) Print the comparison table
tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Total Anesthesia Time (CTT) (min)",
    "Total Anesthesia Time (Pressure) (min)"
  ),
  Value  = c(ctt_tta_val, tta_cp)
) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Metric", "Value"),
    caption   = paste0(
      "Comparison of Total Anesthesia Time by CTT vs Pressure\n",
      "Horse ", sel_horse, " (Treatment ", sel_trt, ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```
